Sustain: Controls the compression amount
Attack: Controls how soon the compressor starts to process the signal 
VOL: Controls the effect output 
Clipping: Controls the input sensitivity

module.name: COMP 3
module.descriptionCn: 全功能压缩
module.descriptionEn: Full - function compression
module.summaryCn:
Threshold： 调节压缩触发的阈值
Ratio： 调节压缩比
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Attack： 调节压缩效果起始时间
Release： 调节压缩释放时间
Tone： 调节压缩音色明亮度
Blend： 调节干湿信号比
module.summaryEn:
Threshold: Controls the compression trigger level 
Ratio: Controls the amount of compression when the compressor is triggered
Output: Controls the output volume/makeup amount
Attack: Controls how soon the compressor starts to process the signal
Release: Controls how soon the compressor starts to release the signal level back to normal after the level drops below the threshold
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Blend: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio

module.name: Octave
module.descriptionCn: 复音八度音效果。
module.descriptionEn: Polyphonic octave effect.
module.summaryCn:
Low：调节低八度效果音的音量
High：调节高八度效果音的音量
Dry：调节干信号的音量
module.summaryEn:
Low: Controls the volume of lower octave (1 oct down)
High: Controls the volume of higher octave (1 oct up)
Dry: Controls the dry signal level

module.name: Pitch
module.descriptionCn: 复音移调效果。
module.descriptionEn: Polyphonic pitch shifter/harmonizer.
module.summaryCn:
High：以半音为单位调节高音和声音高，最大+24（高2个八度）
Low Pitch：以半音为单位调节低音和声音高，最大-24（低2个八度）
Dry：调节干信号的音量
H-VOL：调节高音和声效果音量
L-VOL：调节低音和声效果音量
module.summaryEn:
High/Low Pitch: Controls the low/high pitch shifting range by semitones 
Dry: Controls the dry signal level
H/L-VOL: Controls the low/high pitch volume

module.name: Detune

module.summaryEn:

Dry/Wet: Controls the dry/wet signal level
